releaseNotes.content:
## Introduction

Config script for FrSky RB25 and RB25S.

## Enhancement

- Added and updated relevant configuration items to support the RB25(S) firmware update version 3.0.5.
- Added the option to enable/disable switching ability between different Gyro banks.

## Fixes

- Fixed the issue of calibration failure.

If you are running Ethos 1.6.0 or later, you can find it in the Device Config menu.
